dispositions.topic_text: Whether structurally complete JSON with invalid field values or types counts as a damaged record requiring A6 rule 5 refusal
dispositions.what: Field types, enumeration values, identity and extra fields of a stored record are validated against its closed model.

dispositions.topic_text: How INV-02 tests prove delivery never opens or reads a failing path before rejection
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-02 observes file access to show that a failing path is not opened.

dispositions.topic_text: How INV-19 tests prove a conflicting copy is never read before rejection
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-19 observes file access to show that a conflict copy is not read.

dispositions.topic_text: Source and timing of the file modification-time read
dispositions.what: The modification time comes from the file that was opened for reading, the same instance that supplied its bytes, as State 5 round-11 T3 decides; the listed path supplies it only for a file rejected before it is opened.
